profile.headline: Prisma Access Software Engineer at Palo Alto Networks
profile.summary: I have an artistic flair for mixing technology and design as demonstrated through my professional experience and projects in my website portfolio. I have graduated with a Bachelors of Science in Computer Science from California State University, Long Beach. I am interested in the fields of Web Design/Development, Front End Development and UI/UX Design to further hone my technical skills and make an impact on improving user experience in the tech industry.

positions.title: Prisma Access Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Staff Software Engineer in the SASE IA (Secure Access Service Edge Information Architecture) and NetSec CoPilot UI team, I have supported Palo Alto Network's GA launch of the cyber security's industry's first ADEM Powered by AIOPs and Unified SASE Observability User Experience in Strata Cloud Manager Platform (SCM) and many more projects.

Some of my notable feats include:
• Led 5 frontend engineers as UI lead for ADEM, Palo Alto Networks experience monitoring platform, shipping 10+ React/TypeScript features (D3 root-cause views, AG Grid impact tables) that cut troubleshooting from 3 days to 30 minutes and lifted engagement 50% after GA.
• Saved a millions of dollars enterprise deal from a competitor by extending ADEMs Zoom and Teams call analytics to WebRTC in 5 weeks, shipping the latency, jitter, and packet-loss dashboards that won the evaluation.
• Contributed WCAG-accessible components (e.g. Timeline) to the design system with Storybook docs, ARIA labels, keyboard and screen-reader support, and dark/light theming, adopted by 10+ teams.
• Rebuilt a 20,000+ line JSON-configured legacy UI as typed React/TypeScript micro-frontends on a shared component library with code splitting and lazy loading, halving development time and raising Jest coverage from 30% to 85%.
• Cut load times 80% on 100,000+ row AG Grid tables by moving sorting, filtering, pagination, and export server-side, and replaced a static Figma picker with server-side search across 50,000+ applications.
• Rolled out a platform-wide tenant selector and RBAC navigation with SSO across 10 micro-frontend teams in 3 weeks with zero major regressions, coordinating each teams adoption and deployment timeline.
• Halved QA cycles (4 weeks to 1-2) with shift-left testing: 400+ Playwright E2E tests, 200+ failing tests fixed to a 100% pass rate, Vitest coverage up 25% in a quarter, and CI/CD gates on every merge request.

positions.title: Prisma Access Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
As a Summer 2020 intern, I was able to gain experience with cutting-edge technologies, network and collaborate with colleagues throughout the business and learned about protecting our digital way of life in the cybersecurity industry.

Some of my notable feats include:
• Won 2nd place in Palo Alto Network's internal hackathon with a web application made in Python, Javascript, HTML and CSS that analyzes the privacy and security of a social media account.
• Developed a prototype customer feedback collecting application for GlobalProtect 
using Flask in Python, .NET Framework in C# and MySQL database.
• Analyzed 1,000+ user submitted reviews with a machine learning algorithm which provides analytics and data to be used in planning improvements in functionality and UI/UX for GlobalProtect.
• Created a new resource page containing examples of HTML / CSS widgets, styles, and templates for the rebranding/redesign of Palo Alto Networks’ intranet website.

positions.title: Internal Communications & Design Intern
positions.description:
As a part of OCTA's OCTA’s year-round Emerging Professionals Intern Program, I am able to gain real world work experience and a deeper awareness of transportation’s many facets through OCTA orientation and working with teams on cross-divisional projects. 

Some of my responsibilities include:
• Updated OCTA’s intranet website regularly to promote media distribution throughout the company.
• Compiling bi-weekly data and testing reports from OCTA’s Commuter Club store application.
• Designing digital and print media using Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign for Employee Program news, updates, and events.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Theta Tau is the nation's largest and foremost Professional Engineering fraternity. As part of the Alpha class of CSULB Theta Tau, I helped petition our colony to become the Xi Epsilon chapter of Theta Tau.

As the current President and Founding Member, I have:
• Founded the first and only engineering fraternity on campus and first Theta Tau in the CSU system.
• Created a foundation and culture that emphasizes on profession in the engineering industry.
• Overlooked the executive board and seven committees to ensure engineering and professional success among its members.

As Outreach & Recruitment Lead I have:
• Directed the largest campus-wide marketing campaign in the College of Engineering resulting in the recruitment of over 300+ interest sign-ups and 100+ potential new members each semester.
• Developed the official website and managed social media accounts, winning CSULB Associated Engineering Student Body’s 2019 Out of the Box Organization.
• Produced the fraternity's branding through media advertisements such as logos, banners, fliers, postcards, and posters.
